title: 第十一章紫电狂狮的恐惧第十二章收服紫电狂狮
content_zh:
“人类小子，你有完没完？别以为本王真的惧怕你！！！”看着身后还在穷追不舍的苏阳，紫电狂狮简直郁闷到了极致，它不由后悔起来，自己干嘛要来招惹这个不要命的人类小子。
苏阳根本不搭理紫电狂狮的话，脚下的速度反而又快了起来。
这就是斗战圣法的奇妙之处。
不仅能够让施法者在以最快的速度提升战斗力，还能让其的速度也短时间内增长数倍。
否则以苏阳真正的境界修为，早就被紫电狂狮甩几条街了。
一人一兽都快飞行百里，紫电狂狮眼见自己就要到了山脉深处，到时候将这人类小子往自己的仇敌那边引去，也就用不着自己出手，就能让他必死无疑。
然而，苏阳也知道，再这样拖下去，只会对自己不利。
鬼知道这妖兽山脉深处，还有没有什么其余恐怖的妖兽存在。
于是，只能咬咬牙，强行运转至尊之血的力量。不顾体内此刻遭受的巨大反噬，速度再度提高一倍，眨眼之间便来到了紫电狂狮的背后。
紫电狂狮感受到背后靠近的气息，不由绝望道：“你大爷，哪里来的变态小子？”
咻~
话音刚落，两道亮光闪起的同时，苏阳和紫电狂狮也消失在了虚空之中。
只有一块黑色小石头，此刻正在急速下坠......只是，又有谁会在意呢？
两道身影直接坠落在石块里的星空世界，紫电狂狮好巧不巧的砸在了大圣石像旁边，此刻正晕乎乎的起身道：“艹！本王这是在哪里？这该死的小子对我做了什么？”
当紫电狂狮看清眼前的场景时，瞬间一个激灵起来，瞪着一对铜铃般的双眸，张着嘴巴不知所措的站在原地。
“这小子还真是狠，就连本大圣都有些佩服了。居然不顾自身反噬，强行运转至尊血脉的力量，的确令本圣刮目相看了。”大圣的声音，赫然响彻这一片星空。
紫电狂狮本就还在懵逼中，突然听见有声音传出，急忙俯身环视四周，无比警觉道：“谁？何人在说话？赶紧给本王现身！！！”
“小猫咪，本圣就在你身边呢？怎么？见到本圣，还不下跪？”
话落，一股强大的威压从石像里传出，同时，一股来自血脉压制的颤抖，让紫电狂狮瞬间双膝跪地瑟瑟发抖。
紫电狂狮此刻的内心，简直有种说不出的恐惧感。

今天这是怎么了？好不容易逮着一位人类少年，谁知道这少年并不普通，还t不要命。现在自己又莫名其妙的来到了这处神秘空间，而且....这来自血脉压制的恐惧感，究竟是怎么回事.....
“小猫咪，现在摆在你面前的只有两个选择，一是马上神魂俱灭，二是臣服你旁边昏迷不醒的人类小子。”
“当然，本圣知道，你乃变异的六品妖兽，但你也看见了，你身旁的人类小子可不一般，说不定还会是你未来的福星。本大圣也不勉强你，只给你三息时间，是生是死，你看着选吧。”
紫电狂狮闻言，本就颤抖的身躯，此刻更抖的厉害。
content_en:
"Human boy, are you done yet? Don't think that this king is really afraid of you!!!" Looking at Su Yang who was still chasing behind him, the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion was extremely depressed. It couldn't help but regret that it had come to provoke this desperate human boy.
Su Yang ignored the purple lightning mad lion's words at all, and the speed of his feet became faster again.
This is the wonder of the Holy Law of Dou Zhan.
Not only can the caster increase his combat effectiveness as quickly as possible, but it can also increase his speed several times in a short period of time.
Otherwise, with Su Yang's true level of cultivation, he would have been beaten by the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion a long time ago.
One person and one beast can fly hundreds of miles at a time. The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion saw that he was about to reach the depths of the mountain range. When the time came, he would lure this human boy to his enemy, so that he would surely die without having to take action himself.
However, Su Yang also knew that procrastinating like this would only be detrimental to him.
Who knows if there are any other terrifying monsters deep in the Monster Mountain Range.
Therefore, he could only grit his teeth and forcefully circulate the power of the Supreme Blood. Regardless of the huge backlash that his body suffered at the moment, his speed doubled again, and he was behind the purple electric lion in the blink of an eye.
The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion felt the approaching aura from behind, and couldn't help but said in despair: "Your uncle, where did this perverted kid come from?"
Phew~
As soon as he finished speaking, two bright lights flashed, and Su Yang and the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion also disappeared into the void.
There is only a small black stone, which is falling rapidly... But who cares?
The two figures fell directly into the starry sky world among the rocks. The purple electric lion accidentally hit the stone statue of the Great Sage. At this moment, he stood up dizzy and said: "Fuck! Where is this king? What did this damn boy do to me?"
When the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion saw the scene in front of him clearly, he suddenly became excited. He stared at a pair of copper bell-like eyes and stood there with his mouth open and at a loss.
"This kid is really ruthless. Even this great sage is a little impressed. He actually ignored his own backlash and forcibly circulated the power of the supreme bloodline. This really makes me look at him with admiration." The great sage's voice resounded throughout the starry sky.
The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion was still in a daze when he suddenly heard a voice. He hurriedly leaned over and looked around, saying with great vigilance: "Who? Who is talking? Show yourself to me quickly!!!"
"Little kitten, I am right next to you? What? Why don't you kneel down when you see me?"
As soon as he finished speaking, a powerful coercion came from the stone statue, and at the same time, a tremor from the suppression of blood caused the purple electric lion to kneel on its knees and tremble.
The Purple Lightning Crazy Lion felt an indescribable sense of fear in his heart at this moment.
What happened today? Finally, a human boy was caught. Who knew that this boy was not ordinary, and he was willing to risk his life. Now I have come to this mysterious space inexplicably, and... what is going on with this fear coming from bloodline suppression...
"Kitten, there are only two choices before you now. One is to die immediately, and the other is to surrender to the unconscious human kid next to you."
"Of course, I know that you are a mutated sixth-grade monster, but you have also seen that the human boy next to you is not ordinary, and may be your lucky star in the future. I will not force you, and will only give you three breaths. It is up to you to choose whether you want to live or die."
When the Purple Lightning Crazy Lion heard this, his already trembling body became even more trembling at this moment.
